title: Ghost towns of the world: where places were abandoned, and why
excerpt: I mapped 5,448 abandoned settlements in open data and coloured each by why it emptied: mining, war, disaster, reservoirs, Chernobyl and medieval decline. 80% of Wikidata's ghost towns are American, and only 5% say why.
seo_description: A world map of ghost towns and abandoned villages coloured by why they were abandoned, and what open data does not record.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Ghost towns of the world' beside a world map of abandoned settlements: grey points across the United States, a magenta block over England and coloured points for mining, war, disasters, reservoirs and nuclear zones elsewhere. Text: 5,448 abandoned settlements, coloured by why they emptied; only 5% of Wikidata's ghost towns say why.
